findings.summary: After the eval repair, README/TSDoc (host.ts:79) say console eval prints and resolves value undefined but do not state that eval success never certifies persistence and that `fs.flush()` / the next `restart().unflushedWrites` is the durability receipt (only worker-entry.ts:122 says it).
